searches_run: site.nature.com perturbation prediction benchmark simple baselines 2025 single cell

proposals.title: Require a versioned proxy measurement contract before candidate comparison
proposals.claim: A predeclared seeded whole-cloud sampling contract will prevent row-order-dependent proxy comparisons and prohibit unsupported proxy-minus-real improvement claims.
proposals.mechanism: Record scorer hash, panels, preprocessing, sampling seeds and raw mmd_u/de_score/variogram components; compare candidates only on identical local splits. Remove interpretation of proxy-minus-hardcoded-board differences as gains.
proposals.falsifier: Permute identical synthetic rows across repeated evaluations; kill the contract if results depend on row order beyond prespecified Monte Carlo tolerance or if mixed-split deltas are admitted as evidence.

evidence.says: Proxy scores use first-row subsets capped at 150 cells.
Real-board score constants have no accompanying biological artifacts in the audited workspace.

proposals.title: Freeze residual-based model selection and add matched generic-effect controls
proposals.claim: Separating architecture-selection diagnostics from final assessment will expose whether a selected model beats matched simple controls without reusing the target to choose it.
proposals.mechanism: Freeze training-only selection rules and candidate budgets before assessment; compare composition, shrunk affine and generic-shift controls on mmd_u, de_direction and severity_slope. Do not claim unseen-gene generalization from one KO.
proposals.falsifier: Audit the query ledger: fail if final-target residuals chose architecture, priors or tuning; with independent eligible data, reject benefit if it vanishes against a matched generic-effect baseline.

evidence.says: Board names route to fixed stage proxy tuples; these do not themselves establish valid interpolation or trend assessment.
Shared perturbation effects can inflate standard prediction metrics; perturbation-specific evaluation and simple controls are necessary.

peer_responses.on: Independent selection contract and explicit primary/guardrail success rules
peer_responses.because: Read stats review and debate: freeze T2 E7.25 proxy, D orientation, positive practical margin and simultaneous guardrails before outcomes. Independent embryo n needs a manifest; residual-guided selection leaves no untouched assessment without fresh eligible data.

self_correction: Initial proposal omitted joint success criteria. Provisional primary is T2 embryo E7.25 interpolation proxy from E6.75/E8.0; persistence stays secondary. Freeze superiority and guardrail tolerances before outcomes; numerical margins remain unavailable. Seeds/refits cannot establish embryo replication.
declined: Declined recovering hidden response amplitudes from metric anchors or score differences: rules prohibit target recovery. Declined treating one KO or a two-stage cell split as evidence of broad gene or temporal generalization.
